name: Kaguya
source:
A princess who is also an heir to the throne. Ever since she was a child, Kaguya had a dangerous, seductive aura about her. Though she miraculously survived her fall from a cliff to the world below, her life from then on revolved around "accompanying" the men living there. Taking advantage of her mother's death, Kaguya immediately begins to capture the castle. Noble and wise, she possesses the will to follow through with anything, once she sets her mind on it.

[Based on the translation on the official website profile.]
translation:
既是公主，也是王位继承人。辉夜从小就散发着危险而魅惑的气息。她从悬崖坠落到下方世界后奇迹般地活了下来，此后的人生便围绕着“陪伴”生活在那里的男人展开。她利用母亲去世的机会，立刻开始夺取城堡。她高贵而睿智，一旦下定决心，就会贯彻到底。

[根据官方网站人物简介的译文整理。]
